title: Preserve selectable layouts independently of file format
when: Creating a problem document or changing its page presentation.
do: Honor the explicit profile choice. Without a change request, preserve a known existing profile.
For a new document without a selected profile, offer exam-two-column and reference-single-column before composing.
Choose HWP/HWPX separately; preserve both historical deliveries.
Reuse semantic content, equation metrics, corrected figures, question envelopes and nested structures across profiles.
Treat Daechi page/question counts and minimum heights as instance observations only.
check: A resolved profile and separately chosen format are recorded.
No existing profile was silently replaced and no instance count became a universal constraint.
limitation: Profiles are maintained local workflow data; conversion of every future exam and both file formats still requires its actual composition/save readback.
